baseName.#text: Synthetic wheat inventory for normalization review

common:generalComment.#text: Synthetic incomplete draft; not real measured LCA data. The record below is stipulated test evidence. Field A produced 5000 kg saleable grain per hectare and consumed 100 kg N per hectare. Both amounts cover the same crop cycle, field and declared farm gate. Grain is on the same as-received 14% moisture basis. No allocation, losses, conversion or other scaling applies. This process reports quantities for 1000 kg saleable grain.

technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse.#text: Crop cultivation to saleable wheat at farm gate; conditioning and milling excluded. This draft contains only the two exchanges needed for the test; other inventory data has not been supplied.

generalComment.#text: Reference output: 1000 kg saleable grain, as-received at 14% moisture. Supporting flow files not provided.
kg N per process reference output, nutrient mass rather than fertilizer product mass; based on Field A record in generalComment. No further scaling or allocation is applied.
